about:
I am a Computer Science graduate and Web Developer with 3+ years of practical experience building websites, WordPress projects, eCommerce platforms, and custom web applications.

My experience includes responsive front-end interfaces, WordPress and WooCommerce development, multivendor platforms, and custom applications using PHP, Laravel, React, Python, Django, Node.js, MySQL, and MongoDB. I enjoy turning ideas into functional, user-friendly digital products while continuing to improve my development skills.
